items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: The interviewee mentions Bob Green as the person who interviewed Manzi Campbell and who read the resulting booklet, but no direct personal interaction or relationship between William Russell and Bob Green is described.

ctx.x: Oh, no, no, no. I gave you a thing where I interviewed Paul Barberin about Wilton Crawley's teeth falling out. It was a supplement. This doesn't go on the tape. It was really funny. It was a funny story that Paul Barberin told me.
The funniest story on Wilton Crawley is the one that Bob Green interviewed Manzi Campbell. How do you spell Manzi Campbell? With a Z or an S?
I think with a Z. I thought so, too.
